app.name: ScummVM (FMV blit test RPX)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.short_description: Groovie pixel conversion and rendering diagnostics
app.long_description: Specialized RGBA8888-to-RGB565 SDL conversion and bounded rendering-stage timings. Previous fixes, engines and Ogg/MP3/MT-32 retained. Hardware confirmation is required; non-Aroma RPX unverified. Back up saves/config and read TESTING.md. No games or ROMs included.
